Deadline to Apply
Individual program application deadlines vary.
All students, especially US citizens, should check with the academic department for
specific application deadline information. The contact information for department
coordinators and program websites that house specific deadlines can be found in the
Graduate School directory.
Please note that the application portal will close at 12:00 a.m. EST on the day of
the deadline. DO NOT WAIT UNTIL THE DAY OF THE DEADLINE TO SUBMIT AND COMPLETE YOUR
APPLICATION.
You're advised to monitor both your regular mail (sent to the mailing address you
provided on your electronic application) and your personal e-mail account to stay
informed of any additional requirements for your application.
To determine eligibility and view deadlines for scholarships , please visit the Scholarship Office website.
International students are cautioned to plan extra time for their application and
admissions processes. Suggested dates follow.

Students who have not enrolled continuously and need to be readmitted must be fully
readmitted before the start of classes in each semester. We highly recommend that
students complete the readmission process at least three weeks prior to a term.
